author: Kelly Farmer
paragraphs: My brother Harry had some incredible friends in school. One of which was Alex. Alex's younger sister became my friend! Her name is Nicole! I remember working on a science fair project at her house and it was the same day Alex had just got done with chemo. He was making oatmeal and offered me some. I remember to this day. To think how sick he was and how much pain he was in, and he was looking out for others. Alex was quick to serve and think of others - and I hope to be the same to carry on his amazing legacy.
